items.text: Las Vegas (Wed/Thu): TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) DNP Wednesday, 'day-by-day', back on the field at the start of Thursday practice. DNP - DT Tonka Hemingway (stinger). LIMITED - DT Folorunso Fatukasi (toe), K Matt Gay (hip). DT Thomas Booker full. IR - DE Patrick Johnson. Fernando Mendoza starts.

Denver (off a bye, Wed): no DNPs. Full - WR Jaylen Waddle and CB Riley Moss (both cleared concussions), S Talanoa Hufanga. LIMITED - CB Kris Abrams-Draine, S Brandon Jones (hamstring). IR - RB RJ Harvey, LB Jonah Elliss. Bo Nix starts.
